detail.longDescription: Hello everyone, I built pgBuddy — a tiny Docker container with a web UI to back up & restore multiple PostgreSQL databases. With version 1.4.0 I have migrated from bootstrap 5.3.8 to 6. Now the UI gets a new look 😅 blog post: https:// hostlab.tech/blog/pgbuddy Link to repository: https:// forgejo.hostlab.tech/suitdeer/ pgbuddy # postgresql # postgres # docker # opensource # backup # restore # selfhosted # bootstrap
